findings.title: Port 53 DNS is being intercepted
findings.detail: 208.67.222.222 was asked which OpenDNS server answered and replied "I am not an OpenDNS resolver.". That is the record the public authoritative servers hold, not what an OpenDNS resolver returns, so the query was answered by something else on the path.
